ctgov.note: Compact result returned only the legacy completed Rheos hypertension feasibility (NCT01077180); active BENEFIT-HF IDE pivotal located via direct ctgov API query

pipeline.modality: Implantable neuromodulation device (carotid baroreceptor electrical stimulation)

indications.indication: Heart failure expansion: HFmrEF and HFrEF with NT-proBNP 400 to <5,000 pg/mL (NYHA Class II or III, LVEF <50%)
indications.trial_design: Prospective, multi-center, randomized 2:1 controlled IDE trial; up to 200 sites US/Germany; 2,500 patients; 2-year follow-up; primary endpoint composite of all-cause death, LVAD, heart transplant, and HF events requiring ED visit or hospitalization
indications.trial_status: Enrolling by invitation; FDA IDE granted Nov 2025; trial initiated Jan 2026; CMS Category B IDE coverage; enrollment expected to begin H1 2026 across ~150 centers; enrollment complete within 5 years; trial conclusion 5-7 years

commercial_product.name: Barostim
commercial_product.approval: FDA Premarket Approval (PMA) August 2019 with Breakthrough Device designation; expanded labeling Dec 2023
commercial_product.indication_label: Patients who are NYHA Class III or Class II (with recent history of Class III) despite GDMT, with LVEF <=35% and NT-proBNP <1,600 pg/mL; delivers BAT to improve NYHA functional status, 6MHW, and quality of life

excluded_legacy_terminated.rationale: Completed Phase 2 hypertension feasibility study from 2005-2007; legacy, not part of active pipeline

excluded_legacy_terminated.trial: BAT-in-HF (Phase I), HOPE4HF (Phase II), BeAT-HF (Phase III pivotal)
excluded_legacy_terminated.rationale: Pre-market HF studies completed; supported 2019 PMA approval and 2023 expanded labeling — now historical evidence base, not active pipeline
